moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending August 13, 2026, marking its twentieth non-consecutive week at the top and making it the longest-running UK number-one single of all time.

angles.name: #1 Chart Single
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is Number 1 again on the Official Singles Chart. Can anyone knock them off?

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: History made! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean is officially the longest-running UK Number 1 single ever. What a track!
